text: A hundred and fifty thousand soldiers were marching toward this city.
Its general, Zhuge Liang, had already sent his army away.
say: Its general, Jooguh Lyang, had already sent his army away.

text: He couldn't run. He couldn't fight.
So he did the craziest thing in history.
Told a few old men to sweep the streets.
Then he sat on the wall... and played music.
When the enemy general, Sima Yi, arrived... he froze.
say: When the enemy general, Suh-mah Yee, arrived... he froze.

text: Zhuge Liang never takes risks. This had to be a trap.
say: Jooguh Lyang never takes risks. This had to be a trap.

text: So he turned around. All one hundred and fifty thousand men.
The legend calls it the greatest bluff in history.
